task.title: Raise ValueError for non-numeric CSV plotting columns
task.description: Reject selected CSV columns that cannot be plotted as numeric data while preserving the existing missing-column behavior.
requirements: Preserve the current behavior when both requested columns exist and contain numeric data.
If x_col or y_col exists but is not numeric, raise ValueError before attempting to plot it.
The ValueError message must identify each selected non-numeric column exactly once.
Preserve the existing descriptive ValueError behavior for missing requested columns.
Add meaningful pytest coverage for one and two selected non-numeric columns.
Do not change the command-line interface or unrelated plotting behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Numeric selected columns still return their values.
A selected non-numeric column raises ValueError containing its name.
Two selected non-numeric columns are both identified without duplication.
